text: Recent visitor reviews indicate issues with the food quality at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, particularly with the flavor of several dishes. Two reviews specifically mentioned salads that lacked balance or had strong, unpleasant flavors, and one noted that the venison chili was bland and needed more seasoning. While there was some appreciation for having healthy options, the overall feedback suggests the menu recipes may need adjustment. There were no comments on other aspects of the visitor experience in the last 30 days.

windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days indicate issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several comments mention bland or unbalanced flavors in the salads and chili, with some expressing disappointment in the limited and overpriced offerings. One review also noted a lack of basic service, such as not providing cups for water. Overall, the average rating is low, suggesting that improvements in both food preparation and service are needed.
windows.90: Over the past 90 days, several visitors have expressed dissatisfaction with the food offerings at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, noting issues with flavor, limited menu choices, and preparation quality. Some found certain dishes bland or poorly executed, and there were complaints about the lack of variety and value for the price. A few reviews also mentioned concerns about service and wait times. While the library itself received positive remarks, the food service appears to need attention to better meet visitor expectations.
